kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَاوَى • (sāwā) III (non-past يُسَاوِي (yusāwī), verbal noun مُسَاوَاة (musāwāh))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Compare Hebrew שָׁוָה (shâvâh, “to be even, to be equal, to resemble”).
s: Hebrew שָׁוָה (shâvâh, “to be even, to be equal, to resemble”)
g: to equalize (بَيْنَ (bayna) between something وَ (wa) and something)
to institute parity (بَيْنَ (bayna) between something وَ (wa) and something)
